US Lawmakers Urge FBI Probe into Illinois Hindu Temple Shooting Plot

Over 100 members of the US Congress have urged the FBI to investigate an attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois as a potential hate crime. The incident involved a self-identified neo-Nazi whose rifle malfunctioned during the attack. Lawmakers cited concerns over rising threats against Indian and Hindu Americans.
